newsitem.title: USA: INTERVIEW-Vencor CFO backs consensus view.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW-Vencor CFO backs consensus view.

text.p: Vencor Inc chief financial officer Earl Reed said the firm is comfortable with the First Call consensus 1997 earnings estimate of $2.19 per share.
"We're comfortable with that...$2.19," Reed said in an interview.
Vencor posted 1996 earnings Tuesday of $1.81 per share before non-recurring charges.
Shares in the Louisville, Ky.-based operator of long-term care hospitals, nursing homes and other businesses closed off 1/8 at 36 after it reported fourth-quarter and 1996 earnings.
Reed said Vencor expects its acquisition of TheraTx Inc to be accretive to earnings later this year.
The latest analysts' estimates reflect that expectation, he said, and are up by about $0.02 per share since the acquisition was announced.
